message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openvswitch && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"ofproto/ofproto-dpif-xlate.c","function":"rewrite_flow_push_nsh","line":6030,"var":"encap->props","code":"const char *ptr = (char *) encap->props;","note":"The OpenFlow encap properties blob is the attacker-controlled source for NSH MD2 TLVs."},
  {"step":2,"file":"ofproto/ofproto-dpif-xlate.c","function":"rewrite_flow_push_nsh","line":6040,"var":"prop_ptr","code":"struct ofpact_ed_prop *prop_ptr = ALIGNED_CAST(struct ofpact_ed_prop *, ptr);","note":"The blob is walked as a sequence of typed properties, including NSH TLV descriptors."},
  {"step":3,"file":"ofproto/ofproto-dpif-xlate.c","function":"rewrite_flow_push_nsh","line":6051,"var":"tlv_prop->data","code":"ofpbuf_put(buf, tlv_prop->data, md2_ctx->length);","note":"Each TLV payload is copied into a temporary metadata buffer that becomes the NSH MD2 context."},
  {"step":4,"file":"ofproto/ofproto-dpif-xlate.c","function":"rewrite_flow_push_nsh","line":6070,"var":"buf","code":"if (buf->size == 0 || buf->size > NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN) { ... }","note":"The temporary metadata buffer is kept only if it is non-empty and within the NSH context limit."},
  {"step":5,"file":"ofproto/ofproto-dpif-xlate.c","function":"rewrite_flow_push_nsh","line":6100,"var":"flow->nsh.mdtype","code":"flow->nsh.mdtype = NSH_M_TYPE2;","note":"The rewritten flow is marked as MD2 so the temporary buffer will be emitted later as push_nsh metadata."},
  {"step":6,"file":"ofproto/ofproto-dpif-xlate.c","function":"odp_put_push_nsh_action","line":7688,"var":"encap_data","code":"if (encap_data) { metadata = encap_data->data; md_size = encap_data->size; }","note":"At commit time, the temporary buffer is exposed as the metadata pointer and length for the datapath action."},
  {"step":7,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"nsh_key_to_attr","line":2001,"var":"metadata","code":"if (nsh->mdtype == NSH_M_TYPE2) { if (metadata && md_size > 0) nl_msg_put_unspec(buf, OVS_NSH_KEY_ATTR_MD2, metadata, md_size); }","note":"The push_nsh serializer forwards the MD2 payload into a netlink attribute."},
  {"step":8,"file":"lib/netlink.c","function":"nl_msg_put_unspec","line":244,"var":"data","code":"ptr = nl_msg_put_unspec_uninit(msg, type, size); nullable_memcpy(ptr, data, size);","note":"The sink copies the payload with nullable_memcpy, matching the reported crash state."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true` executed with exit code 0.
